judgment_calls.decision: The page never defines "the emergency patient"; the check_for and the priority are gated on the page entry features the app records: Unresponsive, Cardiac arrest, Respiratory obstruction, Difficulty breathing, SpO2 < 94, RR < 9, SBP < 80, pulse < 50.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Gate only on Unresponsive (Q1 = No); or no gate (fires on any listed criterion alone).

judgment_calls.decision: Emergency, because the page is "The emergency patient" (Will: Emergency where the page explicitly says "Emergency patient").
Comma list read as "any of" SBP < 80, pulse >= 100, RR > 30, confusion/restlessness, weakness.
judgment_calls.alternatives: All of them; or SBP < 80 plus any other. "Any of" fires much more often (e.g. pulse >= 100 alone).

judgment_calls.decision: All of: sudden breathlessness AND (unilateral hyperresonance OR decreased breath sounds OR pain) AND deviated trachea.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Any of the listed features (would make sudden breathlessness alone diagnostic).

judgment_calls.topic: Acute heart failure in the pulse < 50 instability list
judgment_calls.decision: Expanded into footnote 3 (first) features, any of: leg swelling, orthopnoea, dyspnoea on exertion.
judgment_calls.alternatives: clinical_finding Acute heart failure; or leg swelling AND worsening dyspnoea.

judgment_calls.decision: The page prints two footnotes numbered 3; the first (leg swelling…) is attached to "acute heart failure3", the second (shock likely) to "shock3".
Not encoded: a GCS score has no unit in the language.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Proxy via Unresponsive (not invented as a GCS proxy; Unresponsive is encoded from Q1 in its own right).
